editorial.blurb: A warm, welcoming Korean pocha where generous portions of expertly grilled meats and flavorful soups rival Seoul's best, backed by genuinely caring staff.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the thinly sliced beef brisket (chadolbaegi) to grill tableside, and pair it with the thick, fluffy rolled omelet and frozen soju — the staff, especially Eugene, will make sure you're taken care of.
